tools.description: Plan a 1-30 page handwritten Wren notebook and write its cover and contents (page 1; over 8 pages: a cover page and contents pages). tools.name: list_recent_notebooks
tools.description: The user's latest notes, newest first: id, title, subject, pages, last edit, the outline of pages Wren wrote, and the note this chat has been writing to. Use it when the user returns to a topic, then add pages to that noteId.

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Show one note's title, subject, page size and its pages (number, id, ink stroke count, whether Wren can add ink to it). Use it to pick a page to replace (write_notebook_page target.pageNumber) or draw onto (draw_figure).

tools.name: draw_figure
tools.description: Draw ONE standalone figure in the user's Wren notebook, big on its own page: a graph, labelled diagram, chart, table, timeline, flowchart, mind map, concept map, number line or shapes. tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the stable Wren account id (Firebase uid) and basic profile of the currently linked account. Call this after connect_account to confirm linkage.

tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Link the user's Wren account so authored notes land in their notebook. Returns the linked uid when a credential is present; otherwise explains that account linking must be completed first.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List the user's Wren notes, most recently edited first, with id, title, subject and page count. Use it to find the noteId for write_notebook_page, draw_figure or get_note.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "write_notebook_page" is 1485 chars, far longer than this server's median (223). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
